title: Account and data deletion
intro: This page explains how to request deletion of your FinTracker account and associated data, in line with Google Play requirements.

items.login: Open the FinTracker app or website and sign in to your account.
items.section: In the Account section, below Edit Personal Details and Change Password, tap Delete my account.
items.confirm: Confirm deletion by typing DELETE. Removal is permanent and immediate.

items.profile: Profile data (name, last name, and email) and authentication credentials
items.groups: Group memberships and groups you founded
items.local: Local portfolio and watchlist caches on the device/browser after sign-out

retained.title: Data retained
retained.body: We do not keep a copy of your personal data after account deletion. Public market data (quotes and dividends) is not personal and remains in the system. Minimal technical security/operations logs, if any, are kept only when required by law and for the shortest possible period.

period.title: Timeline
period.body: Deletion is processed immediately after confirmation in the app. There is no additional retention period for account data.

offline.title: If you cannot access your account
offline.body: Contact the support email listed on the FinTracker Google Play listing, request account deletion, and provide the email registered on the account.
